label: Bible Study
prompt: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am _____, then am I strong.
verse: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Christ's sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
note: Paul learned this when his thorn in the flesh wouldn't go away — weakness became the strong place.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in _____.
verse: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
note: To a dying thief who asked only to be remembered, Jesus promised paradise — that very day.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the _____ that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
verse: Then the angel of the LORD put forth the end of the staff that was in his hand, and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes; and there rose up fire out of the rock, and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. Then the angel of the LORD departed out of his sight.
note: The angel touched Gideon's offering with the tip of his staff, and fire leapt from the rock to consume it.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the _____ of our lips.
verse: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
note: Hosea's repentance script: instead of bulls on the altar, offer the 'calves' of your lips — words of praise.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your _____.
verse: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.
note: No need to flee in panic: the LORD goes before you, and the God of Israel is your 'rereward' — your rear guard. Covered both ways.
